What is Erata?
Erata is a list of changes to a published book or work. In the case of Force of Will, and other card games, its a list of changes made to printed cards, generally to fix bad wording, or to fix balance problems. This is the official list as of July 28th, 2015 and no new updates have been made to it since then as of August 5th when this is getting posted.

It's always worth checking this list before you play in a tournament, just to make sure you know what your cards do!
